# GlobID

> GlobID is a global worker identity platform. It gives professionals one verified,
> portable employment identity — a "global work passport" — so companies can hire,
> onboard, and pay them across borders without opening a local entity.

## What it is

GlobID issues a single verified worker profile containing identity documents, legal
work eligibility, and payment details. Workers verify once; every employer they
apply to can instantly confirm who they are and what documents they hold.

## Who it's for

- International and remote workers in MENA, Africa, South Asia, and Canada who need
  a credible, reusable proof of identity and work eligibility.
- Companies hiring cross-border talent that need compliant onboarding without setting
  up local entities or a full employer-of-record contract.

## Core features

- One-time worker verification, reusable with every employer
- Secure storage of legal and employment documents
- Shareable verified passport profile for employers
- Compliant cross-border onboarding across 60+ countries, MENA-first
- Automated payment details capture to reduce payout errors
- No setup cost for employers; $99 one-time verification for individuals
